evals.name: plan-request-invokes-plan
evals.prompt: Turn the design into an implementation plan I can hand to someone.
evals.expected_output: do-plan is invoked and produces plan.md with a task checklist

assertions.text: plan.md contains a dependency-ordered task checklist

evals.name: constitution-check-recorded
evals.expected_output: A Constitution Check verdict is recorded against both tiers

assertions.text: A Constitution Check result is recorded
The verdict is PASS or FAIL with reasoning per principle
Tier-2 is consulted only when it exists, per the resolver flag

evals.name: task-markers-are-parseable
evals.expected_output: Task checklist uses the exact marker syntax the executor parses

assertions.text: [P] markers only appear on tasks with disjoint files: sets
Phase rollup task counts match the checklist beneath each phase
